people.name: Abraham
people.line: Patriarch, chosen by God to father His people

translations.web: When the sun was going down, a deep sleep fell on Abram. Now terror and great darkness fell on him.
translations.bsb: As the sun was setting, Abram fell into a deep sleep, and suddenly great terror and darkness overwhelmed him.
translations.kjv: And when the sun was going down, a deep sleep fell upon Abram; and, lo, an horror of great darkness fell
